history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration update the budget guidance to provide more clarity on the establishment, use and reporting of voluntary contribution project positions.
history.administration_response: The Administration considers the recommendation to be implemented and requests its closure. While the Office of Programme Planning, Finance and Budget does not have authority over an entity’s establishment or use of voluntary contribution project positions, the Office ensures, through the regular-budget guide and the provision of templates (form 4), that entities expecting to have such positions in the next budget cycle disclose them in the regular budget fascicle in a detailed manner. In addition, the Office supports entities in managing these positions during the year, notably by maintaining regular liaison with entities and assisting in clean-up exercises (e.g. upon request, with customized organizational management reports to help them to clean up their staffing tables). During the meeting held on 29 April 2025, the Office explained to the Board the enhancement included in the budget guide for the proposed programme budget for 2026 with regard to the disclosure of voluntary contribution project positions, presented form 4 and explained the support provided to entities throughout the year, notably through clean-up exercises and communication.
history.board_assessment: Given that entities, through the regular-budget guide and the provision of templates (form 4), will be requested to provide detailed information on all voluntary contribution project posts and that regular clean-up exercises will be conducted for voluntary contribution projects lasting one year or longer, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
